Usage: astryx theme palette [options] [command]

Create and work with theme-owned color palettes

Options:
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Commands:
  generate [options] <config>  Generate an OKLCH palette candidate for human review

Exit codes:
  0  help is shown or a subcommand succeeds
  1  an unknown subcommand is provided

Examples:
  # Generate a candidate
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme palette generate palette.config.json

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/theme-palette
